Package index

Package

What gsm.bio is for and how its statistics are built.

gsm.bio gsm.bio-package
gsm.bio: statistics and widgets for biomarker charts

Statistics

One function per family of tests, each a thin wrapper around the base R function the design names, and all returning the same result.

Analyze_GroupDifference()
Compare a numeric variable between groups
Analyze_GroupDifferenceBy()
Compare a numeric variable between groups at each level of a column
Analyze_Correlation()
Correlate two numeric variables
Analyze_CorrelationMatrix()
Correlate every pair of several numeric variables
Analyze_Fit()
Fit a line or a smooth to two numeric variables
Analyze_Contingency()
Test the association between two categories
Analyze_Survival()
Compare survival between groups
Analyze_Screen()
Screen many biomarkers with one comparison
Analyze_DifferenceGrid()
The standardised difference for every biomarker at every level of a column
StatisticsResult statistics-result
The result every statistics function returns

Widgets

A bio.viz chart drawn from R, with its statistics computed by the functions above when the widget is made and stored in the page, so a saved page shows them with no R and no network.

Widget_GroupComparison()
Group Comparison Widget
Widget_AssociationScatter()
Association Scatter Widget
Widget_CorrelationMatrix()
Correlation Matrix Widget
Widget_BiomarkerScreen()
Biomarker Screen Widget
Widget_CrossTab()
Cross-Tabulation Widget
Widget_StratifiedSurvival()
Stratified Survival Widget

The app, and widgets in a Shiny page

The six charts as one Shiny app, and the pieces it is made of: the widgets drawn in a Shiny page, where the R session behind the page answers every statistic a chart asks for, so every view a reader reaches has its numbers. shiny is suggested, not imported.

RunApp()
Run the six charts as one Shiny app
Serve_Statistics()
Answer the widgets' statistics from a Shiny session
Widget_GroupComparisonOutput() renderWidget_GroupComparison() Widget_AssociationScatterOutput() renderWidget_AssociationScatter() Widget_CorrelationMatrixOutput() renderWidget_CorrelationMatrix() Widget_BiomarkerScreenOutput() renderWidget_BiomarkerScreen() Widget_CrossTabOutput() renderWidget_CrossTab() Widget_StratifiedSurvivalOutput() renderWidget_StratifiedSurvival()
The widgets in a Shiny page

Figures

The same views as static ggplot2 figures, for a report or a slide, with the same statistics from the functions above, and the chart’s title, subtitle and footnotes. ggplot2 is suggested, not imported.

Visualize_GroupComparison()
Group Comparison Figure
Visualize_AssociationScatter()
Association Scatter Figure
Visualize_CorrelationMatrix()
Correlation Matrix Figure
Visualize_BiomarkerScreen()
Biomarker Screen Figure
Visualize_CrossTab()
Cross-Tabulation Figure
Visualize_StratifiedSurvival()
Stratified Survival Figure

Tables

The same views’ statistics as tables, one row per statistic, written by the program’s display rules, and an RTF writer for a report. r2rtf is suggested, not imported.

Table_AssociationScatter()

Table_CorrelationMatrix()

Table_BiomarkerScreen()

Table_CrossTab()
Cross-Tabulation Table
Table_StratifiedSurvival()
Stratified Survival Table
Write_RTF()
Write a Statistics Table to RTF

Batch

bio.viz’s chart specifications run against a dataset to figures and RTF tables in a folder, one per specification or one per biomarker.

Run_Specifications()
Run Chart Specifications to Figures and Tables
